desc:
📦💗 PACKED WITH CARE 💗📦

Grandma June left you her little spare room… and a dream. Turn it into the coziest online shop on Roblox! 🧸✨

🎀 HOW TO PLAY
📬 Get orders from customers with REAL stories
🧺 Pick their items & arrange them in the box
🎁 Choose wrapping paper, crinkle filler & box colors
🍬 Tuck in treats & freebies (they might notice!)
📮 Ship it out before the deadline!
💌 Read their thank-you messages & reply

✨ FEATURES
🥟 Squishies, slimes, plushies, dumplings & blind boxes
💬 170+ customer stories: sweet, funny & a little sad
👵 Regulars who come back with their own storylines
⭐ Grow your rating to unlock VIP customers
🛒 Restock, upgrade & decorate your shop
🌙 Cozy pixel art, lofi music & dark mode

🎃 PACKS
🎮 90s Nostalgia: handhelds & digital pets
🦇 Pumpkin Patch: spooky slimes & dumplings

🔔 New items every 2 weeks!
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to stay updated!
